name: MFA-Net-LDCT-Benchmark
description: A medical imaging benchmark for low-dose CT (LDCT) denoising and reconstruction that evaluates how well models restore normal-dose CT quality from low-dose inputs. It measures image-to-image restoration fidelity across clinical LDCT datasets using standard image quality metrics. Common use is to compare denoising architectures and training strategies for clinical image quality improvement.
reputation: Niche research benchmark used in LDCT denoising literature with modest but growing adoption in medical imaging research.
